reason: Keep the hunk of a committed or withdrawn workspace_change row while a standing row written before it on the same path still stands, so the path's fold replays it instead of diffing its effect as text. One new partial index over the committed and withdrawn rows of workspace_change by (checkout, path, at, id) reads that history once to build; both retired-text triggers are replaced so the queue only receives rows no earlier standing row holds back, and they find the rows a leaving row releases through that index. No row is rewritten. The installation estimates the index build from workspace_change max(rowid) and the snapshot bytes before replacing the running server.
